narrative.overview: One page that says what Alacrán is in a single read: a large light headline, one illustration of the mechanism, one primary action. The ground is warm grey, content sits on white sheets with hairline rules, ink is near-black, and the only chroma is the scorpion red from the desktop logo. Depth is a single soft shadow and borders.
keyCharacteristics: Light display type (weight 300) with tight tracking; JetBrains Mono only for paths and commands.
Four plain columns, hairline rows and split rows instead of card grids.
One memorable moment: the isometric hero stack.
The desktop app's red scorpion is the mark.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is the only chroma on the page. A new element that wants a second hue uses ink or a neutral instead.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Grey Rule
rules.body: Red text on the ground uses Marker Red, never the fill red; the fill red is for backgrounds and lines.

rules.name: The Light Display Rule
rules.body: Headings above 1.5rem are weight 300 (or 400 in prose) with negative tracking; bold display type is not part of this system.

rules.name: The Mono Is Paths Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono names things on disk or things to type. It is never a decorative label style.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use the single soft shadow or none. No hard offset shadows, no glow on text or cards.

dos: Do keep one primary action per view, in Scorpion Red.
Do use the scorpion raster (landing/logo.png, produced by scripts/generate-logo.py) as the mark; never redraw it.
Do keep every font self-hosted in landing/fonts/.
Do end every generated page body with the Buy Me a Coffee widget script.
Do rebuild generated pages from landing/ with python3 build-site.py && python3 build-md.py && python3 test_landing.py.
Do give every shipping raster a provenance note, and label screenshots as the sample company.
donts: Don't add testimonials, customer counts or benchmarks; none exist.
Don't load fonts from a CDN at runtime.
Don't write an em dash in HTML or CSS; test_landing.py fails on it.
Don't put overflow-x hidden on body; the shipped value is overflow-x: clip.
Don't return to the receipt-book look or a cream page with a mono-label grid.
Don't scatter floating chips, tickers, number strips or decorative badges around sections.
Don't introduce a second accent hue.
